Tom Holland’s Spider-Man in Brand New Day feels closer than ever to the versions we grew up watching.

Tobey Maguire’s Peter Parker was defined by responsibility, sacrifice, and the constant struggle to balance his personal life with being Spider-Man. Andrew Garfield brought a more emotional, rebellious side to the character, especially through his relationship with Gwen Stacy.

Tom Holland started out differently. He had Tony Stark’s technology, the Avengers, and friends who knew his secret. But after No Way Home, everything changed.

In Brand New Day, Peter is completely on his own. No advanced Stark suits, no one who remembers his identity, and no one to turn to when things get difficult. Even his new handmade suit pays tribute to Maguire and Garfield’s designs.

For the first time, Holland’s Spider-Man is experiencing the kind of lonely, everyday struggles that defined the earlier versions of Peter Parker.

Three different Spider-Men, three different generations, but the same responsibility behind the mask.

Which version of Spider-Man is your favorite?
